current_accepted_append.subjects: Vanir: care, appetite, work and conditional loyalty
current_accepted_append.observation: He values a particular friend and dream, seeks paid work and negative emotion, knowingly coerces others, sometimes chooses restraint and once actually leaves to seek another job.
current_accepted_append.implication: Reconstruct competing appraisals and thresholds rather than a secretly pure benefactor or invariant cruel machine.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Own narration is self-serving; loyalty does not excuse harm and the departure does not prove a permanent break.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Wiz: capable rescue, costly care and commercial mistakes
current_accepted_append.observation: Human Wiz executes combat and host rescue, spends life for companions and accepts a transformed future; current Wiz has real successful products but recurrent price, timing and handling failures.
current_accepted_append.implication: Separate tactical skill, moral priority, business function and economic fit by state.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Transformation is not proved to cause all commercial failure; reported outcomes keep their providers.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Aqua: actual useful skills and interpretation-sensitive help
current_accepted_append.observation: She asserts divine identity, makes saleable holy water, perseveres at peeling, misreads a civic request, initiates species aggression and acknowledges a specific protection boundary after intervention.
current_accepted_append.implication: Retain competence and actual noncompliance in the same model; task understanding and pride are causal competitors.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No retroactive rescue of J01service failure or complete behavioral reform.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Yunyun, Luna, Iris and secondary initiative
current_accepted_append.observation: Yunyun has actual admirers and informed objections; Luna performs skilled overburdened work; Iris seeks recognition and later enjoys ordinary freedom; retainers, Leen and succubi independently alter phases.
current_accepted_append.implication: Give secondary subjects their own goals, knowledge and boundaries before deriving limited models.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Unnamed attackers/returning parents are not silently identified; age and rumor scopes remain explicit.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Actual attachment with narrow or absent consent
current_accepted_append.observation: Yunyun can value friendship while rejecting a trick and future fraud; the widow cannot hear the fee; Luna values relief but condemns humiliation.
current_accepted_append.implication: Track affection, informed agreement and imposed labor as distinct relational facts.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Later benefit or payment does not erase prior unwantedness.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Vanir and Wiz: exchange, recognition and a valued shared life
current_accepted_append.observation: Wiz refuses paid separation; Vanir names her, values the relations she enabled and still expects a reciprocal dungeon, with repeated punitive conflict.
current_accepted_append.implication: Particular care can operate inside an explicit instrumental exchange and real instability.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Do not invent a performed romance, unconditional gift or absence of abusive conduct.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Iris and her retainers: real care with competing wishes
current_accepted_append.observation: Guard duty restrains action, indulgence changes choices, Rain corrects false premises and Iris chooses achievement before ordinary reunion.
current_accepted_append.implication: Model guard, education, personal recognition and freedom as distinct phases.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No performed overnight contact, unrestricted royal skill or universally correct restraint.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Succubi: adoration, refusal and reciprocal risk
current_accepted_append.observation: Fans seek a tie, first choose self-defense, later offer to protect their stronger patron and then negotiate divine tolerance and secrecy.
current_accepted_append.implication: Preserve real subordinate initiative and recipient preference under hierarchy.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Apparent youth does not set age; no blanket consent follows from liking a cold superior.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Expectation shifts retain real costs
current_accepted_append.observation: The88selected effects distinguish mistaken premises, misapplied working tools, coercive generosity and public correction.
current_accepted_append.implication: Use the bounded whole-premise register with85H1and3H2; no H3/H4exemption is needed for literal magic, possession or staged death.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Counts describe selections, not all humor, novel population or model accuracy.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Earned closure is repeatedly contested
current_accepted_append.observation: A closing formula conflicts with injuries and escape, then a later external provider actually stops a fight; the final reunion is particular and unnamed.
current_accepted_append.implication: Separate formulaic closure from performed resolution and unresolved downstream costs.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No scene-level reset or universal harm erasure.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Written forms and independently known contexts
current_accepted_append.observation: Every current short form joins its native window, with individual warrants for role, recipient, correction, knowledge and actual act.
current_accepted_append.implication: Japanese segmentation and lexical reinterpretation are separated from pragmatic dependence and portable mechanisms.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Written source only; no audio, native-human validation, census or new blind prediction.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Proper names, titles and ambiguous concern
current_accepted_append.observation: A name signals recognition, repeated role insults conceal familiarity, and concern becomes a deliberately managed romantic inference.
current_accepted_append.implication: Do not classify voice from pronouns or polite endings without actual role and uptake.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: The bonus civil apology needs the independently present provider constraint; it does not revise frozen scores.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Narrator and possession attribution
current_accepted_append.observation: Vanir frames the book, Wiz supplies an early first-person history, and the possessed host’s forced insults differ from her own resistance.
current_accepted_append.implication: Index narrator/date/voice-source changes and preserve actual-body versus asserted-person planes.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No Kazuma-narrated principal chapter is invented from the franchise default; bonus Kazuma is observed by Vanir.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Information access and deliberate nonuse
current_accepted_append.observation: Sight can fail, be limited, be used privately or be deliberately not used, and a story’s intended listener can fall asleep.
current_accepted_append.implication: Preserve actual received knowledge before explaining later action or crediting a correction.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No universal mind reading or retroactive knowledge from reader access.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Company and ordinary rest as concrete preferences
current_accepted_append.observation: People want shared work, game partners, a first treated drink, time off, family return and ordinary festivals.
current_accepted_append.implication: Treat these as real ends alongside quests, money and combat.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Low monetary cost does not make a lost activity trivial or an imposed replacement adequate.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Business scarcity depends on material fit
current_accepted_append.observation: Useful stones can be overpriced, a holy-water batch can sell, a cooler can work and still miss the season, and food poverty can elicit a thug’s charity.
current_accepted_append.implication: Track capital, supply delay, expiry and customer market separately from product function.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No infinite devil lifetime supplies immediate cash, no future sale is assumed and one kindness does not settle all character motives.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Wiz: prepared skill with real targeting errors
current_accepted_append.observation: She checks a chest, rescues a possessed ally with Sleep, confirms recovery, but misapplies an organism-only scroll and a bilateral barrier.
current_accepted_append.implication: Separate appropriate method, actual execution and incorrect world model.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: A failure does not erase the checks or rescue; successful tools are not defective because she misused them.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Aqua: capability, adoption and operational meaning
current_accepted_append.observation: Purification and peeling really work, but the intended civic task is not understood and the succubi themselves defeat the attackers.
current_accepted_append.implication: Match competence claims to the exact known task and actual provider.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No inferred divine competence rescues an adequate opposite case; no all-help-success count.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Outside providers and institutional competence
current_accepted_append.observation: Luna classifies cases and organizes remedies, Leen corrects social beliefs, Wiz fetches Kazuma, and police act after a specific assault.
current_accepted_append.implication: Keep local provider fit and sequential recovery instead of a sole-hero account.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Orders are not completed remedies; police limitations are local source accounts, not present real-world legal advice.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Life risk and actual protection persist through comedy
current_accepted_append.observation: Wiz burns life to rescue companions; Vanir risks repeated body loss to protect others until a fetched provider arrives; the curse is finally lifted.
current_accepted_append.implication: Distinguish biological life, constructed body, remaining lives, transformation and verified cure.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Near loss is not actual decrement; eventual cure does not erase the prior choice or cost.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Unwanted acts keep their ethical and causal force
current_accepted_append.observation: Identity deception, imposed bodily change, engineered humiliation and host coercion remain actual despite later benefits or a forgiving storyteller.
current_accepted_append.implication: Retain the victim’s own objections and the specific consent scope; describe coercion non-graphically.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No species exemption, retroactive permission, universal forgiveness or new intimate act is inferred.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Known costs and omitted warnings
current_accepted_append.observation: A privately known financing obstacle is not communicated; real sales invite risky extra production; seasonal remedy misses expiry.
current_accepted_append.implication: Record when information was received or withheld and which intervention could have changed the next step.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No unsupported causal curse, completed interest payment, cancelled order or final punishment.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Misread jobs and defective success criteria
current_accepted_append.observation: Royal recognition, corpse collection and sticker peeling substitute narrower metrics for the actual social problem.
current_accepted_append.implication: Track actor-owned goals and corrected meanings before judging a whole operation successful.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Useful incidental effects do not prove intended competence; later understanding is not backdated.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Fraud, coercion and self-generated demand
current_accepted_append.observation: Vanir plans reputation-backed inventory fraud; racketeers create their own guard need; Dust stages compensation claims and recruits an uninformed helper.
current_accepted_append.implication: Preserve deliberate agency and later knowledge-based refusal, even where the targeted criminals are unsympathetic.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Planned sales, further rounds and threatened rumors are not completed downstream acts.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Informed exact-contract comparisons
current_accepted_append.observation: All43exact retained sections are joined to unchanged models; observed and absent predicates are argued by actual actor, date, information and resources.
current_accepted_append.implication: Accept descriptive scope and candidates for attributable StageD without a new prospective score or silent trigger change.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: No39new trial count. Four original score files and all earlier adverse dispositions remain exact.

current_accepted_append.subjects: The new bonus’s Kazuma pragmatic case
current_accepted_append.observation: Independent provider refusal and queue pressure precede an actual civil apology and reciprocal serious footing.
current_accepted_append.implication: Retain a favorable informed adjunct with real semantic leverage, rather than scoring politeness from endings alone.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Do not repair the earlier YORI01K08failure or alter the accepted MASK principal score; this bonus was not its new blind trial.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Open program and active continuation
current_accepted_append.observation: The original PVledger is immutable and its existing continuation receives these decisions; no denominator or whole-program completion percentage is asserted.
current_accepted_append.implication: Proceed after complete publication closure to FD, Yorimichi01–04, main excluded components, syntheses, versioned StageD, secondary dispositions and final release.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Same root author and receiver is not independent review; future work and publication remain explicitly open.

source_plane_precision: Actual roles, inferred identities, reported histories, proposals, performed acts, intended recipients and later results remain distinct.
